# Third-party notices

The release bundles include the `sqlite-vec` loadable extension, version `v0.1.10-alpha.4`, from [asg017/sqlite-vec](https://github.com/asg017/sqlite-vec).

GitHub identifies the upstream project license as Apache-2.0. The upstream tag also includes `LICENSE-MIT`; both upstream license texts are included in this directory. The upstream release archive is pinned by SHA-256 in `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
